## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (2)
- `GET /glyph/{glyphToken}/0-255` — Retrieve a glyph image using a token.
- `POST /rt/webauthn-api/get-auth-options` — Request authentication options via WebAuthn.

### Data Read (2)
- `GET /sprite/santurce/5/{5Id}` — Retrieve a sprite image for Santurce.
- `GET /style/santurce/web` — Get web style configuration for Santurce.

### Data Write (5)
- `POST /{id}/{id}` — Submit data associated with two IDs.
- `POST /fc/{fcId}/` — Submit data associated with an FC ID.
- `POST /fc/gt2/public_key/{public_keyId}` — Submit a public key associated with an FC GT2 ID.
- `POST /go/{goId}` — Submit data associated with a Go ID.
- `POST /metrics/ui` — Submit UI metrics data.

### Config (1)
- `GET /v2/{v2Id}/settings` — Fetch settings for a specific v2 ID.

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to M Uber's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access M Uber data without official API access
- Automate actions on m.uber.com (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the M Uber frontend uses
